(Paccupannavāra) Positive (Anuloma) Person (Puggala) 18. Eye element arises to this persoṇ Does ear element arise to that person? To those at the birth-moment who are to obtain eye element but not ear element, eye element rises; ear element does not arise to those personṣ To those at the birth-moment who are to obtain eye element and ear element, eye element arises and ear element also ariseṣ Ear element arises to this persoṇ Does, eye element arise to that person?
